# GPU/Timing

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [CommandTimer.h](CommandTimer.h): Times the labelled passes of one off-screen command buffer, and the buffer end to end. (declares `CommandTimer`)
- [FrameTimer.h](FrameTimer.h): Times each labelled pass of a frame on the GPU, and hands back the most recent frame whose numbers have arrived. (declares `FrameTimer`)
- [FrameTimings.h](FrameTimings.h): How long one labelled pass took on the GPU, two ways. (declares `PassTiming`, `FrameTimings`)
- [GpuTimestamps.h](GpuTimestamps.h): The backend half of frame timing: a fixed set of slots, each holding one in-flight frame's raw GPU timestamps. (declares `GpuTimestamps`)
- [PassShares.h](PassShares.h): When one timed pass had work in flight on the GPU, as up to two intervals in milliseconds from an origin every pass of the frame shares. (declares `PassActivity`, `sharePassTimes`)

<!-- agent-docs:end -->
